findings.title: `get_monitor_environment_context` returns original `monitor.config` instead of modified `config` copy
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` copies `monitor_environment.monitor.config` into `config` (line 160) and converts `config["schedule_type"]` to its display string (line 162), but line 168 returns `"config": monitor_environment.monitor.config` instead of `"config": config`. As a result, the `config` copy and `schedule_type` display conversion are dead code and the raw integer `schedule_type` value is emitted in the monitor context.

findings.title: Incident created before `failure_issue_threshold` failed check-ins have occurred
findings.body: When `failure_issue_threshold > 1`, `previous_checkins` is sliced with `[:failure_issue_threshold]` (line 48), and line 52 only checks whether any returned check-in has `CheckInStatus.OK`. It does not check `len(previous_checkins) < failure_issue_threshold` (or that all `failure_issue_threshold` check-ins are actually in a failed status, as opposed to `IN_PROGRESS`). On a newly created monitor environment with fewer than `failure_issue_threshold` total check-ins, the very first failed check-in will transition the environment to `MonitorStatus.ERROR` and open an incident despite not meeting the configured threshold.
